QuestionStmt.S: What is the mass in grams of 0.25 mol water?

Solution.S:
Mass is given by:

$$\text{Mass} = \text{Number of moles} \times \text{Molar mass}$$

Molar mass of water $\mathrm{H_2O} = 18 \, \text{g mol}^{-1}$.

$$\text{Mass} = 0.25 \, \text{mol} \times 18 \, \text{g mol}^{-1} = 4.5 \, \text{g}$$

Thus the correct option is C.
